planSteps.description: The page heading reads "Service Requests" and the subtitle mentions approving and scheduling resident service requests
A table lists requests, each row showing a tracking reference beginning REQ- and a request type
Open the first request in the list

description: The service requests queue lists resident service requests with their REQ tracking references, and opening one shows its type, the requesting resident and its current status.
